findings.evidence: In the diff `IsRefl` occurs only at line 254 (`variable (hB : B.IsRefl)`) and in the docstring at 35-36; the Minkowski section (319-422) has no such lemma. Mathlib's `IsSymm.isRefl` is available (mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/SesquilinearForm/Basic.lean:204 uses `H.isRefl`).
findings.fix: Add, in the Minkowski section, `theorem isSymm_minkowskiProduct : ((minkowskiProduct (d := d)).toBilinForm).IsSymm` (from Physlib's symmetry of `minkowskiProduct`) and use `.isRefl` for the reflexive hypothesis; optionally state the Minkowski instances of the splitting and self-adjointness with no side condition.
findings.issue: The Minkowski section supplies no `IsRefl`/`IsSymm` witness for `(minkowskiProduct (d := d)).toBilinForm`, so the three theorems gated on `hB : B.IsRefl` — `mem_transverse_iff_bilinForm_eq_zero` (259), `bilinForm_eq_plus_mul_minus_add` (277), `isSelfAdjoint_transverseProj` (288) — cannot be applied to `minkowskiAxis` or to any `LightConeBasis (minkowskiProduct _).toBilinForm` without the consumer first reproving symmetry of the Minkowski product. The headline splitting `u · v = u⁺v⁻ + u⁻v⁺ + u_T·v_T` is exactly what the roadmap's §0.2/§1.1 consumers need in Minkowski space.

findings.evidence: simp rewrites subterms before the enclosing application, and `minkowskiAxis_nPlus`'s LHS `(minkowskiAxis i).nPlus` is a subterm of every goal stated in terms of the basis vectors; `transverseProj_apply` (180) carries no `@[simp]`, so nothing recovers the goal after the expansion.
findings.fix: Drop `@[simp]` from `minkowskiAxis_nPlus`/`minkowskiAxis_nMinus` (keep them as plain restatements), and give the coordinate expansions `minkowskiAxis_plus`/`minkowskiAxis_minus` low priority (`@[simp low]`) so the basis-vector normal forms fire first.
findings.issue: `@[simp]` on `minkowskiAxis_nPlus` (363) and `minkowskiAxis_nMinus` (369) rewrites `(minkowskiAxis i).nPlus/.nMinus` into `(√2)⁻¹ • (basis _ ± basis _)` by default, so for the only concrete instance in the file the abstract normal-form simp lemmas no longer match: `nPlus_nMinus_eq_one` (98), `plus_nPlus`/`minus_nMinus` (121-135), `transverseProj_nPlus`/`_nMinus` (211-217). `simp` on e.g. `(minkowskiAxis i).transverseProj (minkowskiAxis i).nPlus = 0` expands the argument into coordinates and then has no lemma for `transverseProj` (its `_apply` is not simp), leaving a goal that `transverseProj_nPlus` would have closed. `minkowskiAxis_plus`/`_minus` (376, 384) match `(minkowskiAxis i).plus v` for arbitrary `v` at the same priority as `plus_nPlus`, so which normal form wins is not determined either.

summary: The abstract surface is minimal, bodies are unexposed, and the projector API correctly reuses Mathlib's `IsProj` without wrapper duplication. But the `IsRefl`-gated half of the API is unusable on the file's only concrete model (no reflexivity/symmetry witness for `minkowskiProduct.toBilinForm`), and the `@[simp]` coordinate expansions of `n±` defeat the abstract simp normal forms for that same model.
